# Video Shotcraft attribution

The local shot components adapt work by VincentWei from [video-shotcraft](https://github.com/Vincentwei1021/video-shotcraft).
The upstream source uses Apache License 2.0. The complete license is in `LICENSE` beside this notice.
`sources.json` records the exact upstream revision, source paths, and original SHA-256 hashes.

The adaptations replace upstream branding, fonts, fixture pages, and dependencies with this project's assets and React components.
They preserve the word-reveal channels, chapter handoff, synchronized panel push, and staged brand lockup.
The chapter reveal reserves a reading hold for the actual title length. The outro adds a final one-second hold.
Decorative grains, demo UI, imported audio, and motion-blur dependencies are omitted.
